<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$t = wp_insert_term('Bulgaria', 'ws_country');
$tid = is_wp_error($t) ? $t->get_error_data() : $t['term_id'];
foreach (array('Test Chapter Sofia', 'Test Chapter Plovdiv') as $name) {
  $id = wp_insert_post(array('post_type'=>'ws_chapter','post_title'=>$name,'post_status'=>'publish','post_content'=>'Test chapter.'));
  wp_set_object_terms($id, array((int)$tid), 'ws_country');
}

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php';
$dir = wp_upload_dir();
foreach (array('test-image-a' => array(30,90,200), 'test-image-b' => array(200,60,30)) as $n => $c) {
  $im = imagecreatetruecolor(1200, 1600); imagesavealpha($im, true);
  imagefill($im, 0, 0, imagecolorallocatealpha($im, 0,0,0,127));
  imagefilledellipse($im, 600, 800, 1000, 1400, imagecolorallocate($im, $c[0],$c[1],$c[2]));
  imagestring($im, 5, 560, 790, 'TEST', imagecolorallocate($im,255,255,255));
  $f = $dir['path'] . "/$n.png"; imagepng($im, $f);
  $id = wp_insert_attachment(array('post_mime_type'=>'image/png','post_title'=>$n,'post_status'=>'inherit'), $f);
  wp_update_attachment_metadata($id, wp_generate_attachment_metadata($id, $f));
}
